description: MUTATES one existing Food Diary row the authenticated user owns. Required: food_id (UUID). Optional patch (same fields as log_food): what, kind, dish_items, place, merchant, notes, append_notes (concat), consumed_at (ISO instant) / meal_period (profile TZ), amount, currency, paid_by / payment_method, with / people_names / person_ids. dish_items replaces the complete ordered dish list. Unknown or other-user food_id returns an error and does not create a row. Syncs the mirrored calendar event and rebuilds life_state. Requires API key or OAuth with scope context. Share tokens cannot write. ($0.10; API key required)

description.description: Alias for what (the dish, not notes).

dish_items.description: Complete replacement ordered dish list; [] clears it.

food_id.description: UUID of a food diary row the authenticated user owns

meal_period.description: Spoken period when consumed_at is omitted, e.g. "late lunch"

merchant.description: Restaurant, stall, or shop. Empty or null clears

notes.description: Replaces notes. Empty or null clears

payment_method.description: Alias of paid_by for expense-style agents

person_name.description: One companion to add, by name

place.description: Venue or location. Empty or null clears

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

what.description: Full updated dish/drink text (replaces, does not append). Example: Salmon Bento + hot tea

with.description: Companion names, aliases, or ids to add (does not remove existing tags)
